name: Cangheng
recruit_msg: The old hermit strokes his beard: "I am Cangheng. Take this blade—I walk with you."

name: Nightingale
recruit_msg: Shadow lifts the cloak: "Call me Nightingale. You're interesting—bring me along."

name: Ivan
recruit_msg: The bookkeeper adjusts his glasses: "Ivan. Finally someone who gets magic! Let's go!"

name: Serra
recruit_msg: The white-robed priestess joins her hands: "I am Serra. Your journey needs healing light—let me come."

name: Grey
recruit_msg: The old hunter nods: "Call me Grey. Looks like you need a guide."

name: Bloodraven
recruit_msg: The bounty hunter lowers the hood: "...Bloodraven. Your archery's solid. I approve."

name: Wuchen
recruit_msg: The cell monk presses palms together: "This humble monk is Wuchen. Donor, allow me to aid you."
